title: rewardRate = rewardBudget / windowDuration floor-divides to zero when budget < windowDuration, stranding dust

classification.assetImpact: Per-reset dust-stranding below ~3.15e8 wei of phUSD (sub-nanocent). Total accumulates with pool activity but remains economically negligible. Secondary: enables F-04 Instance C modifier bypass under zero-rate state.
attackPath: 1. Each _syncBudget reset recomputes rewardRate = rewardBudget / windowDuration, truncating residue.
2. Over pool lifetime, dust accumulates as unemittable remainder.
3. In the zero-rate limit (budget < windowDuration seconds), emissions stall entirely until owner top-up.
classification.likelihood: high for dust accumulation (happens every sync), but per-event magnitude is economically irrelevant.

justification: Low/QA. Textbook dust-stranding case - per C4 special-cases guidance, 'Dust amounts (rounding errors)' classify as QA/Low. Quantified per-reset loss of ~3.15e-10 phUSD is far below any economic threshold. The linked zero-rate modifier bypass (F-04 Instance C) is itself Low. Fix (ACC_PRECISION scaling on rewardRate) is purely numerical hygiene.
